style_tags: Genshin Impact anime style, cel-shaded character art, vibrant fantasy colors, soft outline anime aesthetic, magical elemental effects, Teyvat world environment, clean detailed character illustration, Liyue Harbor setting, cinematic 9:16 vertical composition

planned_arc.note: Pre-locked season-1 arc EP1-EP10. Scenarist follows this as RAILS: keep the locked key_lines and cliffhanger lines verbatim, adapt each episode's beats into 3-5 clips under serial-drama constraints (max 2 chars per frame, I2V = micro-motion only, all combat/running/chases = CUT between clips not animation, protagonist always faces camera, cliffhanger spoken line = Avatar TTS). Childe is the reluctant protector — his every action should read as either threat or sacrifice until the last episode. No on-screen text. After shipping an episode, fold its loops/status into characters[], active_loops, episode_summaries. Do NOT re-invent episodes while this arc has unshipped entries.

episodes.title: The Order
episodes.link: Series opening. Lumine witnesses Fatui giving Childe the order to bring her in.
beats: Northland Bank at night. A Fatui Agent hands Childe a sealed scroll.
Childe breaks the seal, reads it. His expression darkens.
He drops the scroll into a candle flame.
Lumine watches from the shadows — she saw everything.
Childe senses her presence and turns. The Agent turns too.
Childe steps between Lumine and the Agent.

cliffhanger.scene: The Agent stares at Childe, waiting. Cold silence.
cliffhanger.line: Prove she matters less than your orders.

loops: what exactly the order says
why Fatui want Lumine now
whether Childe will obey

episodes.title: Leave Liyue
episodes.link: After EP1 Childe is caught between orders and his own choice. He tries to push Lumine away — harshly.
beats: Rain-soaked street in Liyue Harbor.
Lumine follows Childe. He stops abruptly.
She demands answers. He tells her to leave the city today.
She refuses.
A Fatui watcher is spotted on the rooftop above.
Childe draws his weapon — aimed at Lumine.

key_lines.speaker: Lumine
key_lines.line: Then look me in the eye when you say it.

cliffhanger.scene: Childe's blade points at Lumine. Rooftop watcher still watching.

loops: whether Childe is threatening her or protecting her
how much the Fatui watcher saw
what happens if Lumine doesn't leave

episodes.title: Fake Fight
episodes.link: Childe stages a fake attack on Lumine to fool the Fatui — without telling her.
beats: Narrow street. Childe strikes first — fast and deliberate.
Lumine blocks. She doesn't know if it's real.
Childe whispers one word: 'Play along.'
Lumine fights back harder — genuinely angry.
The Fatui watcher on the rooftop takes aim at Lumine.
Childe sees the rifle. He steps into the shot.

cliffhanger.scene: Childe drops to one knee. His shoulder is bleeding.

loops: how badly Childe is hurt
whether Lumine forgives the deception
if the watcher reported back to the Agent

episodes.title: Not Your Mission
episodes.link: Lumine hides the wounded Childe. She bandages him — and finally forces out the truth.
beats: Empty teahouse after closing. Lumine wraps Childe's shoulder.
He tries to make light of it. She pulls the bandage tighter.
Childe admits: the order was always about her.
Lumine pulls her hands away. Silence.
The Fatui Agent enters through the door.
Childe stands up and puts himself between them.

key_lines.speaker: Lumine
key_lines.line: Then why do you keep lying?

key_lines.speaker: Childe
key_lines.line: Because the truth wouldn't stop you.

cliffhanger.scene: The Agent looks at Childe's bandaged shoulder. His eyes say everything.

loops: whether the Agent reports Childe's defection to Snezhnaya
what Lumine decides to do now that she knows
how far Fatui will escalate

episodes.title: The Betrayal
episodes.link: To save Lumine, Childe pretends to hand her over — without warning her.
beats: Childe slowly steps back from Lumine, toward the Agent.
The Agent orders him to bring her closer.
Lumine stares at Childe — pure hatred.
Childe grips her wrist. She almost breaks free.
He leans close and whispers in her ear.
The Agent steps forward. Childe meets his eyes and blinks.

cliffhanger.scene: Lumine's fist connects with the Agent. Childe smiles.

loops: whether the Agent is truly down or just subdued
if Lumine forgives the setup
how many more Fatui are nearby

episodes.title: Run With Me
episodes.link: They escape together — but Lumine is furious that Childe made the call without her again.
beats: Night port. Lumine and Childe sprint through the docks. Fatui behind them.
Childe is running on the wounded shoulder. She notices.
She grabs his arm to help him. She's still angry.
They duck into the shadow of the Golden House entrance.
Lumine demands he stop deciding things for her.
Childe says without the setup she wouldn't have played along.
The Golden House doors open from inside.

key_lines.speaker: Lumine
key_lines.line: I'm not a piece on your board.

cliffhanger.scene: Inside the Golden House, Fatui are already waiting.
cliffhanger.line: How romantic. You both came yourselves.

loops: how Fatui got inside Golden House first
whether Childe's shoulder holds for another fight
what Lumine decides about trusting him

episodes.title: Golden House Again
episodes.link: Fatui trap them in the Golden House and order Childe to prove loyalty by fighting Lumine for real.
beats: Inside the Golden House. Childe and Lumine face each other across the chamber floor.
The Agent orders Childe to prove his loyalty.
Childe raises his weapon.
Lumine holds his gaze. No fear.
Combat begins. Childe strikes near her — not at her.
Lumine notices the pattern. Behind her a Fatui soldier charges.

key_lines.speaker: Lumine
key_lines.line: Don't you dare go easy on me.

key_lines.speaker: Childe
key_lines.line: I'm not going easy on you.

cliffhanger.scene: Childe's blade flies past Lumine — and pins the charging Fatui soldier to the wall.
cliffhanger.line: You were protecting me the whole time?

loops: how many Fatui are in the chamber
whether the Agent accepts what just happened or escalates
what Lumine does with this revelation

episodes.title: Choose Her
episodes.link: The Fatui realize Childe has chosen Lumine over Snezhnaya. He is declared a traitor.
beats: Fatui soldiers fan out around them.
Childe is breathing hard but smiling.
The Agent gives him a final ultimatum.
Lumine tells Childe not to do anything reckless.
Childe tears the Fatui insignia from his coat.
The Agent's expression turns to ice. Fatui charge.
Childe and Lumine fight side by side for the first time.

cliffhanger.scene: The Agent retreats toward the exit, calm.
cliffhanger.line: The port is already sealed. She can't leave.

loops: how Childe plans to get Lumine out of a sealed port
what Snezhnaya does when they learn he defected
whether the Agent has more soldiers waiting outside

episodes.title: Don't Follow
episodes.link: Childe draws the Fatui off alone so Lumine can reach the ships.
beats: Dawn. Liyue Harbor port.
Lumine spots Fatui soldiers blocking every ship.
Childe shows her a shortcut through the warehouse — a clear path to the water.
She understands: he isn't coming with her.
He smiles and pulls the warehouse door closed between them.
She hears the clash of battle on the other side.
She starts toward the ships.
She stops. She turns back.

key_lines.speaker: Childe
key_lines.line: It's very much my style though.

cliffhanger.scene: Lumine re-enters through the warehouse. Childe is on his knees before a ring of Fatui soldiers.

loops: whether Childe can still fight
how many Fatui soldiers remain
what Lumine does next

episodes.title: Come Back Without Orders
episodes.link: Lumine returns and saves Childe herself. The season ends on an open promise.
beats: Lumine charges into the Fatui circle.
Childe tries to push himself upright.
She steps in front of him.
The Agent arrives. He surveys the scene — too many witnesses at the open port.
He orders the Fatui to fall back.
The soldiers leave. The port goes silent.
Childe and Lumine stand alone on the empty docks.
He reaches into his coat and returns something she dropped — her travel pouch.
He turns to leave first.

key_lines.speaker: Lumine
key_lines.line: You were supposed to be the enemy.

cliffhanger.scene: SEASON CLIFF. Childe steps back. One last look over his shoulder.
cliffhanger.line: Next time I'll come back without orders.

characters.status: EP2: Tried to push Lumine away on a rain-soaked Liyue street. Told her to leave the city. His allegiance remains ambiguous to any observer.

episode_summaries.summary: Teaser hook: Lumine's face half-hidden in shadow, watching something unseen. Northland Bank interior at night — Agent hands Childe a sealed scroll. Childe reads it, expression darkens, drops it into candle flame. Lumine witnesses from alcove shadows. Agent speaks the order aloud. Lumine steps partially out: 'This is about me?' Childe puts himself between them: 'You shouldn't have come here.' Lumine: 'Too late.'
episode_summaries.cliffhanger: Agent cold and measured: 'Prove she matters less than your orders.'
episode_summaries.notes: 8 clips: 3 I2V action (clips 1-3, 5+7+5s) + 5 Avatar dialogue (clips 4-8, trimmed to TTS). Chatterbox voice clone. Narrator VO overlay on clips 1-3.

episode_summaries.summary: Opening: Lumine calls out to Childe's retreating figure in the rain — raw desperation. Wide establishing shot: both figures on rain-soaked Liyue lane, rooftop watcher silhouette spotted. Childe turns and confronts. He orders her to leave today. She refuses and demands he look her in the eye. He draws his hydro blade — aimed at her.
episode_summaries.cliffhanger: Childe's blade extended toward Lumine. He whispers: 'I'm sorry. They're watching.'
